references.text: Deborah is introduced as a prophetess and judge in Israel, who judged the people under the Palm of Deborah.
Samuel is described as one raised up by the Lord to lead Israel, just as Deborah was raised up as a mother in Israel.
Describes the oppression of Israel under Jabin and Sisera, which left the villages of Israel desolate until Deborah arose.
Describes a similar situation where Israel lacked leadership and weapons, and the Philistines oppressed them.
The Lord raised up judges to save Israel from the hand of their enemies, just as Deborah was raised up as judge and deliverer.
Kings and queens are to be foster fathers and foster mothers for God's people, a similar maternal image for the nation that Deborah represented.
